turns.learner: Hello! Can you give me an exercise on he, she and it with -s?
turns.tutor:
Yes! First I will do one, step by step.
"I sleep eight hours." Now I want "he".
Step 1: find the subject. It is "he".
Step 2: he, she or it means one other person or thing, so add -s: "He sleeps eight hours."
Rule: after he, she or it, add -s to the verb.
Right: She reads before bed. Wrong: She read before bed.

Now you. Write only the verb:
Write the correct form: My sister ___ (play) tennis on Sundays. (answer with only the verb)
